_note: Steps to upgrade an installed copy from one schema_version to the next.
Fresh installs run db/schema.<driver>.sql in full, then get stamped with the highest key here.
Pre-bucket installs (before schema_version existed) report version 0 and walk the whole file;
v1/v2 never shipped to a buyer, so '3' is the first real step.
The Migrator tolerates these per-statement errors so a half-applied step can re-run:
mysql 1060 duplicate column / 1061 duplicate key / 1091 missing column-key on DROP;
sqlite duplicate column / already exists / no such <object>.

v4 repairs a generator defect: PRIMARY KEY was emitted for MySQL only, so on SQLite `settings` / `game_tag` / `collection_game` had no uniqueness at all. The step dedupes first (a UNIQUE INDEX on dirty data would abort the upgrade and strand the buyer), then creates the index. `mysql` is an empty list on purpose — that baseline always declared these keys, so there is nothing to repair.

v5 adds the licence ledger (game_licenses.audited_at/audit_verdict + license_audits) — the CREATE TABLE inside it is byte-identical to db/schema.mysql.sql / schema.sqlite.sql, which tools/verify_php.py re-checks on every run so the baseline and the upgrade path cannot drift.

3.note: leaderboard time buckets: period + period_key columns, bucket-aware unique keys
mysql: ALTER TABLE `leaderboard` ADD COLUMN `period` VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'all' AFTER `score`
ALTER TABLE `leaderboard` ADD COLUMN `period_key` VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'all' AFTER `period`
sqlite: ALTER TABLE "leaderboard" ADD COLUMN "period" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'all'
ALTER TABLE "leaderboard" ADD COLUMN "period_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'all'
UPDATE "leaderboard" SET "period" = 'week', "period_key" = "week_key" WHERE "week_key" <> ''
UPDATE "leaderboard" SET "period" = 'all', "period_key" = 'all' WHERE "week_key" = ''
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS "uq_leaderboard_game_id_user_id_week_key"
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS "idx_leaderboard_game_id_week_key_score"
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "uq_leaderboard_game_id_user_id_period_period_key" ON "leaderboard" ("game_id", "user_id", "period", "period_key")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "uq_leaderboard_game_id_alias_period_period_key" ON "leaderboard" ("game_id", "alias", "period", "period_key")
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "idx_leaderboard_game_id_period_period_key_score" ON "leaderboard" ("game_id", "period", "period_key", "score")
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "idx_leaderboard_period_period_key_score" ON "leaderboard" ("period", "period_key", "score")

4.note: constraint repair: sqlite was missing PRIMARY KEY on settings/game_tag/collection_game
sqlite: DELETE FROM "settings" WHERE rowid NOT IN (SELECT MAX(rowid) FROM "settings" GROUP BY "key_name")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "uq_settings_key_name" ON "settings" ("key_name")
DELETE FROM "game_tag" WHERE rowid NOT IN (SELECT MIN(rowid) FROM "game_tag" GROUP BY "game_id", "tag_id")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "uq_game_tag_game_id_tag_id" ON "game_tag" ("game_id", "tag_id")
DELETE FROM "collection_game" WHERE rowid NOT IN (SELECT MIN(rowid) FROM "collection_game" GROUP BY "collection_id", "game_id")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "uq_collection_game_collection_id_game_id" ON "collection_game" ("collection_id", "game_id")

5.note: licence ledger: game_licenses.audited_at/audit_verdict cache + append-only license_audits
mysql: ALTER TABLE `game_licenses` ADD COLUMN `audited_at` DATETIME NULL AFTER `status`
ALTER TABLE `game_licenses` ADD COLUMN `audit_verdict` VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' AFTER `audited_at`

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `license_audits` (
  `id` INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `game_id` INT NOT NULL,
  `license_id` INT NULL,
  `verdict` VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
  `mode` VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'dynamic',
  `rules_version` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `reasons` TEXT NULL,
  `details` TEXT NULL,
  `audited_at` DATETIME NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_license_audits_game_id` FOREIGN KEY (`game_id`) REFERENCES `games` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_license_audits_license_id` FOREIGN KEY (`license_id`) REFERENCES `game_licenses` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_license_audits_game_id_audited_at` (`game_id`, `audited_at`),
  KEY `idx_license_audits_verdict` (`verdict`),
  KEY `idx_license_audits_rules_version` (`rules_version`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
INSERT INTO `settings` (`key_name`, `value_type`, `value_text`, `updated_at`) VALUES ('license.rules_version', 'int', '1', NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE `value_text` = '1'
sqlite: ALTER TABLE "game_licenses" ADD COLUMN "audited_at" TEXT NULL
ALTER TABLE "game_licenses" ADD COLUMN "audit_verdict" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "idx_game_licenses_audit_verdict" ON "game_licenses" ("audit_verdict")

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "license_audits" (
  "id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  "game_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES "games" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
  "license_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES "game_licenses" ("id") ON DELETE SET NULL,
  "verdict" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'dynamic',
  "rules_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "reasons" TEXT NULL,
  "details" TEXT NULL,
  "audited_at" TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_license_audits_game_id_audited_at ON "license_audits" ("game_id", "audited_at");
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_license_audits_verdict ON "license_audits" ("verdict");
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_license_audits_rules_version ON "license_audits" ("rules_version");

INSERT INTO "settings" ("key_name", "value_type", "value_text", "updated_at") VALUES ('license.rules_version', 'int', '1', datetime('now')) ON CONFLICT("key_name") DO UPDATE SET "value_text" = excluded."value_text"
